# core/md5.bastio

<!-- Generated by tests/libref.py from core/md5.bastio: edit the source, then run tests/libref.py --write. -->

MD5 (RFC 1321) and HMAC-MD5 (RFC 2104).

MD5 is broken for collision resistance: use it only where a protocol
demands it (the Linux AF_ALG interface, legacy checksums), never for
signatures or passwords.

What is proved: every access is in bounds, nothing leaks, and a digest is
16 bytes. Not proved: that the digest is MD5's (the tests check the
RFC 1321 and RFC 2202 vectors, including the block-boundary lengths 55,
56, 63, 64 and 65), or that the code takes the same time for every input.

`import "core/md5.bastio";` also loads [core/option.bastio](core-option.md), [core/bytes.bastio](core-bytes.md), [core/endian.bastio](core-endian.md), [core/text.bastio](core-text.md).

| Function | |
| --- | --- |
| [`md5`](#md5) | The MD5 digest of `m`. |
| [`hmac_md5`](#hmac_md5) | HMAC-MD5 of `msg` under `key` (any length). |

Every example below is built, verified and run by `tests/run.sh`. An `assert` in one is proved at compile time from the contracts above it.

## Functions

### `md5`

```bastio
fn md5(m: &Bytes) -> Bytes
  ensures blen(result) == 16
```

The MD5 digest of `m`: 16 bytes.

Example:

```bastio
let m = bfrom("abc");
let d = md5(m);
let first = bget(d, 0);          // 90 01 50 98 3c d2 4f b0 d6 96 3f 7d 28 e1 7f 72
let last = bget(d, 15);
let n = blen(d);
bfree(d);
bfree(m);
if n != 16 || first != 144 || last != 114 { return 1; }
```

### `hmac_md5`

```bastio
fn hmac_md5(key: &Bytes, msg: &Bytes) -> Bytes
  ensures blen(result) == 16
```

HMAC-MD5 of `msg` under `key` (any length): 16 bytes.

Example:

```bastio
let key = bfrom("key");
let msg = bfrom("The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog");
let mac = hmac_md5(key, msg);
let first = bget(mac, 0);        // 80 07 07 13 ... 75
let last = bget(mac, 15);
bfree(mac);
bfree(key);
bfree(msg);
if first != 128 || last != 117 { return 1; }
```

## Internals

### `md5_k`

```bastio
fn md5_k() -> Vec[u32]
  ensures vlen(result) == 64
```

Internal: the 64 additive constants floor(2^32 * abs(sin(i + 1))).

### `md5_s`

```bastio
fn md5_s() -> Vec[u32]
  ensures vlen(result) == 64
```

Internal: the 64 rotation amounts.

### `md5_rotl`

```bastio
fn md5_rotl(x: u32, n: u64) -> u32
  requires n >= 1 && n <= 31
```

Internal: `x` rotated left by `n` (1..31) bits.

### `md5_block`

```bastio
fn md5_block(h: &mut Vec[u32], k: &Vec[u32], s: &Vec[u32], m: &Bytes, at: u64)
  requires vlen(h) == 4 && vlen(k) == 64 && vlen(s) == 64 && at + 64 <= blen(m)
  ensures vlen(h) == 4
```

Internal: the four state words after the 64-byte block at `at` of `m`.
